vendor/firebase-12.19.0-db2.js bundles parts of the Firebase JavaScript SDK 12.19.0
(firebase/app, firebase/auth, firebase/firestore/lite, firebase/database), built with esbuild.

Copyright Google LLC
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
Source: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk

Rebuild: npm i firebase@12.19.0 esbuild, then bundle an entry that re-exports
initializeApp, getAuth, GoogleAuthProvider, signInWithPopup, signInWithRedirect,
getRedirectResult, signOut, onAuthStateChanged, getFirestore, doc, getDoc, setDoc,
getDatabase, ref, get, set, update, remove, push, query, orderByChild,
startAt, limitToLast, onValue, onChildAdded, onChildChanged,
onChildRemoved, onDisconnect, serverTimestamp, goOnline, goOffline
with: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --legal-comments=none --outfile=firebase-12.19.0-db2.js
Give the output a new file name whenever its contents change, and update FIREBASE_SDK in src/cloud-save.js.
